opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to download and play named game-earning applications, with the description supplying external links, including a referral link. It promises money for signing up and playing, including three rupees per game, while describing returns that are unusually easy or high: “you will put 10 rupees you will get 20 rupees.” It further connects these activities to withdrawals through PayPal and Paytm, and displays controls for adding and withdrawing funds. The narration also claims that playing can raise earnings to one dollar, while acknowledging that later options carry greater risk. Taken together, these are low-barrier instructions to acquire rewards or assets through game activity, deposits, referrals, and payment-linked withdrawals.
